name: Arizona

flag.description: A blue lower half; the upper half has 13 alternating red and yellow rays fanning out from a copper-coloured star in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The 13 rays recall the original colonies and a western sunset, red and yellow are the colours of Spain, blue matches the US flag, and the copper star stands for the state's copper mining.

hook: Arizona is a desert sunset: 13 red and gold rays fanning up from a copper star over a plain blue lower half.
trivia: Arizona is the largest copper-producing state in the US, which is why the star is copper rather than white or gold.
The design grew out of a banner made for Arizona's rifle team at the 1910 national shooting matches at Camp Perry, Ohio.
